component.name: gjsify SDK Extension
component.summary: Node-free gjsify build toolchain for GJS apps

description.p: Provides the gjsify command-line build toolchain inside a Flatpak build sandbox, so a GJS/GNOME application can run "gjsify build" at build time without a network connection or a Node.js toolchain. The extension ships the committed GJS bundle of the gjsify CLI together with its native Rolldown and LightningCSS bridges (GObject-Introspection typelibs + shared libraries), mounted at /usr/lib/sdk/gjsify.

Enable it in a build with: append-path "/usr/lib/sdk/gjsify/bin" and source /usr/lib/sdk/gjsify/enable.sh in the build-commands. The GJS runtime itself is provided by the consuming SDK (org.gnome.Sdk), exactly as the node24 extension relies on the base SDK.
